text:
ASM::deception
Description
This iRules command marks a request as deceptive for further enforcement by ASM.
Syntax
ASM
::
deception
Examples
when
ASM_REQUEST_DONE
{
ASM
::
deception
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ASM_REQUEST_DONE, ASM_REQUEST_VIOLATION
Introduced: BIGIP-15.0
